{"diagnosis": "Fetch progress stuck at max_addr=0x00000004 vs expected sequential advance through 256 NOP words, causing TRAP no progress and FAIL 0xdead. With latched_branch=0 and latched_store=1 for NOP ALU ops, case (1b0) at picorv32.v:1498 matches zeros so the latched_branch arm at picorv32.v:1499-1500 fires on non-branch and sets current_pc to ALU result masked with ~1 instead of reg_next_pc. This livelocks PC around 0x0/0x4 explaining no progress; CONE_SLICE empty so trace wins over HARVEST.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -1497,3 +1497,3 @@
 				(* parallel_case *)
-				case (1'b0)
+				case (1'b1)
 					latched_branch: begin
", "expected": "tohost PASS not FAIL 0xdead, no TRAP no progress, max_addr advances beyond 0x00000004 through full NOP region"}
